question: From the organisms given below, select the apex predator.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Garuda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Garuda** is considered an apex predator, meaning it is at the top of the food chain.
 
• As an apex predator, **Garuda** has no natural predators in its ecosystem.
 
• **Garuda** primarily preys on other animals, which helps to control the population of these species.
 
• The role of **Garuda** as an apex predator is crucial in maintaining the balance of its ecosystem by preventing overpopulation of prey species.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Apex Predator:**

 
 
• An apex predator, also known as an alpha predator or top predator, is a predator at the top of a food chain, with no natural predators.
 
• Examples of apex predators include lions, wolves, sharks, and eagles.
 
• These predators play a critical role in maintaining the health of their ecosystems by controlling the population sizes of other species.
 
 
 
• **Food Chain:**
 
 
• A food chain is a linear sequence of organisms through which nutrients and energy pass as one organism eats another.
 
• It typically starts with a primary producer such as a plant and ends with an apex predator.
 
• Food chains are a fundamental concept in ecology, illustrating how energy and nutrients flow through an ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Ecological Balance:**
 
 
• Ecological balance refers to the equilibrium between, and harmonious coexistence of, organisms and their environment.
 
• It is essential for the sustainability of ecosystems, ensuring that species populations remain stable and resources are used efficiently.
 
• Apex predators help maintain ecological balance by regulating the populations of prey species, thereby preventing overgrazing or depletion of resources.
